# `PlanetStack`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Progress and result of stacking a recorded planetary/lunar/solar video.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | event (device sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER (observation only) |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, PlanetStackFunc @0x3320f0, progress_call_back @0x332b00, PrintPlanetStackState @0x3330e0, procedure table @0xaadb88 (64-bit build); procedure table @0x72c318 (32-bit build) |

Function producer (PlanetStackFunc named PlanetStack): Function-state family (SendFuncEvent): state is always written; stage only when non-empty; lapse_ms when the timer is started or the state is terminal; code and error at fail even when the stored code is 0 (cancel omits them); route optional. A null or nameless detail sends nothing, and non-working notifications can be suppressed while the function cache still changes, so a receiver cannot rely on seeing every transition. Its formatter adds percent, input_thn when non-empty and output_file on success. The algorithm progress callback also sends direct working events with percent (capped at 99), procedure_code and procedure, and the worker sends a direct fail with code and error (state family) when stacking returns non-zero. Callback-driven; no fixed timer. The 32-bit build has the same three formatter members and the same five-entry procedure table; cadence parity is unresolved. Recipients: all retained 4700 sockets. No reply-before-event order is established: the RPC reply that starts the worker and the worker's events can arrive in either order. No fixed cadence.

Side effects: Observation only for the receiver. The worker writes the stacked output file.

## Request params

None. Events are sent by the device without a request; the payload is below.

## Payload

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Event` | string | yes | - | Discriminator. Fixed value `"PlanetStack"`. [READ] |
| `Timestamp` | string | yes | - | Decimal string with nine fractional digits from a monotonic clock; not a calendar time. [READ] |
| `state` | string | yes | - | Function producer: idle, working, complete, fail, cancel. Direct producers use working (progress callback) and fail. One of: `idle`, `working`, `complete`, `fail`, `cancel`. [READ] |
| `stage` | string | if non-empty stage string held | - | Only when a non-empty stage string is held. [READ] |
| `lapse_ms` | integer | if function producer: timer started (working) or terminal state | - | Elapsed milliseconds, independent of Timestamp. Working (or any state with a start and no end time, including complete) uses current monotonic minus start; other terminal states use end minus start. [READ] |
| `code` | integer | if state is fail | - | Function producer: at fail even if 0. Direct fail (NotifyState) when stacking returns non-zero, with error. [READ] |
| `error` | string | if state is fail | - | Message for code; present with code. Lookup failure gives fail to operate. [READ] |
| `route` | array<string> | if optional; absent is a legitimate branch | - | Function-tree ancestry (for example View, Stack) built at send time. May be absent; not an address. [READ] |
| `percent` | integer | if function producer (always written by its formatter); direct progress events | - | Stack percentage. The direct progress callback caps it at 99. [READ] |
| `procedure_code` | integer | if direct progress events | - | Processing-stage number from the algorithm callback, 0 to 4, mapped to procedure: 0 read frame calculate score, 1 calculate average frame, 2 create ap griad, 3 calculate frame qualities, 4 stack frames. Same table in both builds; the out-of-range default name was not checked. [READ; out-of-range default unresolved] |
| `procedure` | string | if direct progress events | - | Processing-stage name for procedure_code 0 to 4 (create ap griad is the firmware spelling). One of: `read frame calculate score`, `calculate average frame`, `create ap griad`, `calculate frame qualities`, `stack frames`. [READ] |
| `output_file` | object | if function producer, function code 0 and output buffer non-empty | - | Saved stacked result, `{path, files}` with one file entry; set after the result is saved. [READ] |
| `output_file.path` | string | yes | - | Output directory, relative to the storage root, without a trailing slash. [READ] |
| `output_file.files` | array<object> | yes | - | One object for the saved file; the builder pushes a single entry (no loop). Range: at least 1 item(s). [READ] |
| `output_file.files[].name` | string | yes | - | File path relative to the storage root. [READ] |
| `output_file.files[].date` | string | yes | - | Image date from the image metadata. [READ] |
| `output_file.files[].thn` | string | yes | - | Thumbnail name. [READ] |
| `output_file.files[].type` | integer | yes | - | Album file-type code [READ] |
| `input_thn` | string | if non-empty | - | Input thumbnail name. [READ] |

## Errors

None. Failures appear in the payload (`code`, `error`) when `state` is `fail`.

## Example

Event, progress - Direct progress (READ shape; values invented):

```json
{"Event":"PlanetStack","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"working","percent":37,"procedure_code":2,"procedure":"create ap griad"}
```

Event, complete - Function completion (READ shape; values invented):

```json
{"Event":"PlanetStack","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"complete","lapse_ms":182000,"percent":100,"input_thn":"Jupiter_thn.jpg","output_file":{"path":"Planet","files":[{"name":"Planet/Stacked_Jupiter.jpg","date":"2026-01-01 00:00:00","thn":"Planet/Stacked_Jupiter_thn.jpg","type":0}]}}
```
